Class ScriptExport

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.simulation.ScriptExport
public final class ScriptExport extends Object
The HTML export of a simulation model of Python or R: the page runs the same script in the web browser, Python with Pyodide (Python and numpy in WebAssembly), R with webR (R in WebAssembly). Both are loaded from their servers when the page is opened (an internet connection is needed). The page gets the settings, the buttons and the chart of the running model and the loaded data of a geospatial model.
